subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: After the PR is rebased against current main, should maintainers land this narrow waited-A2A transcript-artifact suppression as its own fix or consolidate it with the broader A2A duplicate-delivery work?
rationale: The patch has good proof and no concrete code finding, but it changes message-delivery suppression semantics and now conflicts with current main, so a maintainer needs to accept the delivery boundary and refreshed merge result.

options.title: Rebase And Land This Slice
